summary: Enhance your leadership skills with our Charisma Training Course. Learn to project confidence and presence to inspire and influence others effectively.
lede: Charisma training helps experienced professionals strengthen leadership presence to guide teams and gain stakeholder support. Participants practise persuasive verbal communication, non-verbal authority, emotional self-regulation, stakeholder mapping, and structured feedback. They also develop strategic narratives and adapt their communication for virtual and hybrid settings.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals who have mastered their technical domains and now need to amplify their influence to drive broader organizational goals.
audience: High-potential (HiPo) Professionals identified for future executive
modules: Foundations of Executive Presence and Influence
The Neuroscience of Charisma and Connection
Leading in Hybrid and Digital Environments
prerequisites: Participants should currently hold a management or supervisory role, or be identified as a high-potential individual for a future leadership position. A basic understanding of organizational structure and experience leading project teams or functional units is recommended. No prior psychological or behavioral science training is required.
